pages.text: New chunks in The Slimic can contain collapsed mines. Timber entrance frames, abandoned equipment, or an open quarry shaft make them visible from the surface. They appear on dry, fairly level ground.

Tunnel sites have a descending entrance and a $(l:companions/tunnel)3×3 passage$(). Fallen supports, rubble, webs, and an unfinished rock face show where digging stopped. The main passage remains accessible.

Quarry sites expose a 16×16 chunk and descend 12–18 blocks. Their two-block-wide perimeter stairs follow the $(l:companions/mining)Mining Slime’s$() normal pattern. A remaining ledge and fallen workers mark the last unfinished layer.

These Broken Slime Blocks are empty, dried remains. Slimeballs cannot revive them. Clear remains, rubble, and webs before assigning workers; Mining Slimes cannot remove the webs. Your own fallen companions still use normal $(l:care/revival)revival$(). New workers start waiting.
